items.name: unidentified health and beauty item
items.note: The line names only a department (health and beauty), which mixes eligible medicine with ineligible personal care; the item can't be classified.

items.name: digital thermometer
items.note: A thermometer is a device used in diagnosing illness.

items.name: adjustable knee brace
items.note: Supports aren't named in the sources; they are medical equipment when used to treat an injury or condition, not when worn for general athletic use.

items.name: compression socks 15-20 mmHg
items.note: Not named in the sources; compression garments treat circulatory conditions but are also worn for comfort or sport. Eligible only for a medical condition.

items.name: non-prescription polarized sunglasses
items.note: Non-prescription sunglasses are an item ordinarily used for personal purposes.

items.name: melatonin 5 mg, 90 count
items.note: Herbal supplements and 'natural medicines' aren't includible unless recommended by a practitioner for a diagnosed condition.
